description: Source code for a firmware utility tool that handles firmware image creation, inspection, and wrapping with support for custom headers and checksum validation.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and options for the firmware utility.

methods.name: print_auh_header
methods.description: Prints details of an AUH header.

methods.name: print_stag_header
methods.description: Prints details of a STAG header.

methods.name: print_sch2_header
methods.description: Prints details of a SCH2 header.

methods.name: find_auh_headers
methods.description: Searches buffer for AUH headers and validates them.

methods.name: check_stag_header
methods.description: Validates a STAG header checksum and integrity.

methods.name: check_sch2_header
methods.description: Validates a SCH2 header checksum and integrity.

methods.name: inspect_fw
methods.description: Inspects firmware file for headers and checksum correctness.

methods.name: check_options
methods.description: Checks and retrieves file info based on options.

methods.name: fill_sch2
methods.description: Fills SCH2 header with firmware data and checksum.

methods.name: fill_stag
methods.description: Fills STAG header with firmware data and checksum.

methods.name: fill_auh
methods.description: Fills AUH header with device-specific info and checksum.

methods.name: build_fw
methods.description: Builds a firmware image with headers and data.

methods.name: wrap_fw
methods.description: Wraps firmware image with AUH header.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point handling command-line options and executing firmware operations.
